summary: Clara CLI feature fully tested. All 17 features verified: CLI toggle button visibility, CLI panel opening, welcome message, /commands, /health, /roles list, /roles repair, /users list, /site info, /site features, /clear, arrow key command history, Send button, API access-status, API execute, API pending-requests, and API approve endpoints.
critical_code_review_comments: cli.py: Well-structured with proper access control - system/network admins get auto-approved is_admin_override
cli.py: All commands properly routed and implemented with appropriate response types (success/warning/error/info)
ClaraCLI.js: Clean implementation with data-testid attributes for testing
ClaraCLI.js: Uses JetBrains Mono monospace font with proper color coding (cyan=input, emerald=success, amber=warning, red=error, zinc=system)
ClaraCLI.js: Arrow Up/Down history navigation works correctly
MainSiteDashboardLayout.js Line 1179: CLI button correctly rendered for admin users
context_for_next_testing_agent: Clara CLI feature fully implemented and tested. CLI toggle button (data-testid='cli-toggle-btn') visible for admins at bottom-right. CLI panel (data-testid='cli-panel') has terminal styling with JetBrains Mono font. All commands work: /commands shows 5 categories, /health shows 5 system checks, /roles list shows 8 roles, /users list shows 10 users, /site info shows site details, /site features shows 10 enabled features, /roles repair confirms default roles, /clear clears terminal, arrow keys navigate history. Backend API tests all pass: access-status returns is_admin_override=true for network admins, execute runs commands, pending-requests returns list, approve returns 404 for invalid requests.
